outcome: Placental gene expression of inflammatory markers (toll-like receptors 2 and 4, interleukin-6 and -8, tumor necrosis factor-α)
Placental gene expression of growth factors (leptin, adiponectin, insulin-like growth factors 1 and 2, hepatocyte growth factor, hepatocyte growth factor receptor, insulin receptor)
cohort: Obese (BMI ≥35.0 kg/m2) and normal weight (BMI 18.5-25.0 kg/m2) women with uncomplicated pregnancies and term deliveries, matched for age, gestational age, parity, and mode of delivery
finding: There was no significant difference in the placental gene expression of inflammatory markers or growth factors between obese and normal weight women.
